set system host-name DeviceA.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set system login user huawe123 password.command: set system login user huawe123 password 0 $1$c$%L%Jn3hY$5^%T5I\4HGF>j|si~,s,{.@FpH*2XGM\R;7#$
set system login user huawe123 password.explanation: 配置系统登录用户的密码。

parameters.name: username
parameters.explanation: 登录用户名。

parameters.name: password-type
parameters.explanation: 密码类型，0表示明文密码。

parameters.name: password
parameters.explanation: 用户的密码。

set system authentication login default-.explanation: 配置系统认证登录方式为默认本地认证。

parameters.name: login-method
parameters.explanation: 登录认证方式，default-local表示使用本地默认认证方式。

set system authorization exec default-lo.explanation: 配置系统执行命令的授权方式为默认本地授权。

parameters.name: exec-method
parameters.explanation: 执行命令的授权方式，default-local表示使用本地默认授权方式。

parameters.name: service-status
parameters.explanation: 服务状态，enable表示启用服务。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: Interface name, e.g., g-1/0/0.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet address 192.168.1.1/24.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: ip-address
parameters.explanation: The IPv4 address assigned to the interface.

parameters.name: subnet-mask
parameters.explanation: Bits of IPv4 subnet mask.

set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] set destination address [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.command: set security nat source rule-set grpc rule any set destination address 0.0.0.0/0
set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.explanation: 配置NAT源地址转换规则集中的规则，设置目的地址。

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: 规则集名称，例如grpc。

parameters.name: rule-name
parameters.explanation: 规则名称，any表示匹配任何条件。

parameters.name: destination-address
parameters.explanation: 目的地址，0.0.0.0/0表示匹配任何地址。

set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] set destination port [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.command: set security nat source rule-set grpc rule any set destination port _rpc_tcp_20000
set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.explanation: 配置NAT源地址转换规则集中的规则，设置目的端口。

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: 规则集名称，例如grpc。

parameters.name: rule-name
parameters.explanation: 规则名称，any表示匹配任何条件。

parameters.name: destination-port
parameters.explanation: 目的端口，_rpc_tcp_20000表示特定的端口号。

set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.template: set security nat source rule-set [parameter1] rule [parameter2] state [parameter3]
set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.command: set security nat source rule-set grpc rule any state enable
set security nat source rule-set grpc ru.explanation: 启用NAT源地址转换规则集中的规则。

parameters.name: rule-set-name
parameters.explanation: 规则集名称，例如grpc。

parameters.name: rule-name
parameters.explanation: 规则名称，any表示匹配任何条件。

parameters.name: state
parameters.explanation: 规则状态，enable表示启用规则。
